title: Future Reveals ‘The Real Me’ Cover Art & Track List: ‘Who U Think Featured on My Album’
contentText:
Future is gearing up for a summer takeover. Ahead of The Real Me ‘s arrival later this week, Pluto shared the official cover art and track list for the LP on Wednesday (July 8).

Future posted the cover art to Instagram, which finds him shirtless, delivering a menacing stare into the camera with his twists freshly dyed blonde and a black backdrop.

“Who u think featured on my album,” he wrote, seemingly revealing there will be guests on the LP, but he’s not ready to share them just yet, as fans may have to find out Friday (July 10).

The album boasts 22 tracks in total and includes the previously released single “Radio.” Song titles include “California Girls,” “Fukk a Interview,” “Snow in Skyami” and “2018.”

Future is seeking his 12th No. 1 album atop the Billboard 200 collectively. His last nine solo albums, including the pair he teamed up with Metro Boomin on the production side in 2024, all reached the summit.

Before he announced plans for an album in June, Pluto has been keeping busy for the last couple of months. He ended his beef with  Drake  in May to reunite on ICEMAN ‘s “Ran to Atlanta,” which peaked at No. 2 on the  Billboard Hot 100 .

The Atlanta rap dignitary also teamed up with Tyla for a  FIFA World Cup 2026 anthem titled “Game Time.” They joined forces for the live debut of the collab in June for the World Cup’s Opening Ceremony at SoFi Stadium.
